Deep inside Thais' {wiki:Ancient Temple}, past the rotworms, the orcs and a room full of poison fields, there is a well that leads to a room guarded by three {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}. Take the key from a skeleton, go down the well, kill the ghouls and open the door to receive a {item:Garlic Necklace} and a {item:Club Ring}.
Or {wiki:Antidote|antidote} to cure poison if you run through the fields
Bring {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field Runes} or a way to cure poison: there is a whole room of {item:Poison Field|poison fields}.
1. Going down through the Ancient Temple
Leave **Thais** by the **north** gate and go to the {wiki:Ancient Temple}, just northwest of that gate. Go down **2 floors** and head **north**, to the far north end of the big room.
Through the Rotworms to the stairs
Go down to the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} and follow the path **east**, **south** and **east** again. Go down the stairs.
Path through the rotworms to the stairs
Watch out for {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen}, {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors} and a possible {creature:Fire Devil} lured by other players.
This room is full of {item:Poison Field|poison fields}. Run across or use {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field} to clear a path. On the other side, go down the stairs.
Follow a small tunnel **east** and then **north**.
The tunnel east and north to the skeleton room
2. The key and the Ghoul room
You arrive in a room with {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}. **Open** the dead skeleton in the **southeast** corner of the room to get the {item:Key 3600}.
With the key, **use** the well in that room to go down.
Kill the Ghouls and open the door
Kill the 3 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, open the door with the {item:Key 3600} and collect the reward: {item:Garlic Necklace} and {item:Club Ring}.

To leave, go back the same way: return from the ghoul room to the skeleton room (above, where the well is), follow the tunnel **south** and **west**, climb the stairs, cross the {item:Poison Field|poison fields} again and climb the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}' stairs. Then climb the floors of the {wiki:Ancient Temple} up to the surface and return to Thais through the north gate. Bring a {item:Rope}, which is always useful for climbing out of caves.
